mentions.name: Bloodborne VR
mentions.description: A native VR reimagination of the game Bloodborne. All interactions have been redesigned to feel physical in VR and combat has been retuned, so it plays less like the original and more like a native VR experience. A GitHub repository hosts the project and a YouTube video shows gameplay.
